desc:
💪Welcome to Muscle Prison Run!🔥

Are you ready to break out of Prison?! Well let's do this! Today is Muscle Barry’s Shift and he isn't exactly the most vigilant guard in the Prison. This gives us more of an advantage to make our escape.
🏆🏆🏆🏆🏆
Make your way through 25 challenging Obstacles and make it to freedom.
Once you beat the game on Easy mode why not challenge yourself to the HARD MODE. With more obstacles and traps to beat.
